account_replaced.title: PGE replaced the billing account for PPE {ppe}

confirm.title: Move to the new account?
confirm.description:
Account **{old_account}** ({title}) was archived and supply point PPE {ppe} is now billed on account **{new_account}**.

After the move the integration reads the new account. Entities, their IDs and all history stay unchanged.

Before moving: make sure the final invoice of the old account is paid — its balance will no longer be tracked. The new account may not have a settlement invoice yet; until then settlement and energy bank sensors may be unavailable.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.account_unavailable: The new account is no longer listed by PGE. Try again after the next refresh.
abort.new_account_configured: The new account is already added as a separate integration ("{other}"). Remove it, then come back to this repair — history is kept in the current entities.
